name: Yale Platinum 3 Star Cylinder 35/35 (70mm) - Nickel
description: Yale Platinum Euro Profile cylinder is a TS007 3 Star Kitemarked Anti-Snap security product to provide maximum security against known attack methods. The Platinum 3 Star cylinder is independently tested by BSI to be awarded the British Kitemarked TS007:2014 3 Star accreditation. Suitable as a replacement product on PVCu, wood and composite doors, this cylinder has a horizontal keyway, superior strength with a cylinder stability system and an anti-snap sacrificial front section. It is recommended for use on doors that require a high level of security and attack protection. TS007 is a standard developed in response to concerns over cylinder attacks. The standard is characterised by a 3 Star rating system, and can be achieved by combining a 1 Star cylinder with a 2 Star security door furniture or using a standalone 3 Star cylinder. The Platinum series cylinder is approved to TS007 3 Stars and does not require any additional security furniture. Available in double and thumbturn variants, matt black, polished brass and nickel plated finishes.
breadcrumb_str: Home > Products > Hardware & Security > Door Locks & Latches > Yale Platinum 3 Star Cylinder 35/35 (70mm) - Nickel

name: Yale Platinum 3 Star Cylinder 45/35 (80mm) - Nickel
description: Yale Platinum Euro Profile cylinder is a TS007 3 Star Kitemarked Anti-Snap security product to provide maximum security against known attack methods. The Platinum 3 Star cylinder is independently tested by BSI to be awarded the British Kitemarked TS007:2014 3 Star accreditation. Suitable as a replacement product on PVCu, wood and composite doors, this cylinder has a horizontal keyway, superior strength with a cylinder stability system and an anti-snap sacrificial front section. It is recommended for use on doors that require a high level of security and attack protection. TS007 is a standard developed in response to concerns over cylinder attacks. The standard is characterised by a 3 Star rating system, and can be achieved by combining a 1 Star cylinder with a 2 Star security door furniture or using a standalone 3 Star cylinder. The Platinum series cylinder is approved to TS007 3 Stars and does not require any additional security furniture. Available in double and thumbturn variants, matt black, polished brass and nickel plated finishes.
breadcrumb_str: Home > Products > Hardware & Security > Door Locks & Latches > Yale Platinum 3 Star Cylinder 45/35 (80mm) - Nickel

name: Fernox F1 Central Heating Protector & Inhibitor - 500ml
description: Fernox Protector F1 is a premium central heating inhibitor that prevents corrosion and limescale build-up, ensuring long-lasting system efficiency. Its unique blend of inhibitors forms protective layers on metal surfaces, safeguarding boilers, radiators, and pipework, including aluminium systems. With enhanced pH buffering, it maintains the ideal water pH (6.5-8.5) for optimal performance. Suitable for all water types, a single dose treats up to 130 litres or 16 radiators, offering reliable protection and improved system efficiency.

name: Fernox F3 Central Heating Cleaner - 500ml
description: Fernox F3 Central Heating Cleaner is a universal, pH neutral, non-foaming liquid cleaner that removes sludge, scale, and debris from central heating systems.When commissioning new systems, it is advised to use F3 Cleaner to remove flux residues and other installation debris. name: Fernox F4 Central Heating Leak Sealer - 500ml
description: Fernox F4 Central Heating Leak Sealer is an internal leak sealer designed to treat small, inaccessible leaks and weeps within a central heating system that can cause pressure loss. Once added to the system, the product finds the area of oxygen ingress and forms a polymer to seal the pinhole leak. It is effective within 1 to 24 hours of application and doesn't cause blockages in the boiler, pumps, or other system components. A leak can be quickly and efficiently sealed without the need for a complete system drain-down.
